title: Capital Plan Memorandum — The Quarter's Limit on Class H Preferred Stock Redemption Payments, Member Equities & Patronage
content:
The board limits what Cottonwood Plains Farm Credit pays on Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock redemptions in each calendar quarter. The current quarter runs from 1 July 2026 to 30 September 2026.

## Amount paid on an approved redemption

1. The par amount paid on an approved redemption is the lesser of the amount named on the holding's latest approved preferred redemption request and the quarter's redemption allowance; when paying that amount would leave less than the class's smallest balance after a partial redemption on the holding, the whole holding is paid instead.
2. The quarter's redemption allowance is 25 percent of the redemption allowance base, rounded half up to the cent.
3. The redemption allowance base is the shares the holding carried at the start of the current quarter, that is its present shares (purchases plus reinvested dividends less retirements) less its latest reinvested dividend and its latest purchase when either is dated inside the quarter, plus its latest retirement when that is dated inside the quarter.

## Terms used

- **Latest** reinvested dividend, purchase or retirement: the entry of that kind with the latest effective date on the holding.
- **Inside the quarter**: dated on or after 1 July 2026 and on or before 30 September 2026.
- **Whole holding**: the present shares, to the cent.
- **Smallest balance after a partial redemption**: the class figure in the capital plan schedule (USD 1000 for Class H Preferred Stock).

## Worked figures (hypothetical holdings)

**Holding A.** Purchases USD 78,000.00 (latest dated in 2024), reinvested dividends USD 3,000.00 (latest USD 850.00 dated 15 July 2026), retirements USD 1,000.00 (latest dated in 2025). Latest approved request names USD 30,000.00.

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| Present shares | 78,000.00 plus 3,000.00 less 1,000.00 gives 80,000.00 |
| Start-of-quarter shares (the 15 July 2026 dividend is inside the quarter) | 80,000.00 less 850.00 gives 79,150.00 |
| Allowance: 25 percent of 79,150.00 | 19,787.50 |
| Lesser of 30,000.00 and 19,787.50 | 19,787.50 |
| Left on the holding | 60,212.50 — not below USD 1000 |
| Paid | USD 19,787.50 |

**Holding B.** Same holding, latest approved request naming USD 5,000.00: the lesser of 5,000.00 and 19,787.50 is USD 5,000.00, leaving 75,000.00; USD 5,000.00 is paid.

**Holding C.** Present shares USD 1,200.00, no entry inside the quarter, latest approved request naming USD 300.00. The allowance is 25 percent of 1,200.00, USD 300.00; paying 300.00 would leave 900.00, less than USD 1000, so the whole holding, USD 1,200.00, is paid.
